title: 第25章 洞府第26章 蛇团
content_zh:
“你这整体看上去勉强能蒙混过关，就是你这身材太寡淡了。”
洛红颜托着下巴，品鉴道。
她给长卿简单涂抹了些胭脂，遮掩住他惨白的面色，又把他的长发梳起，看起来像是女子的发型。
不过对于长卿的身材，她还不是很满意。
确实不怪她吹毛求疵，这洞中的女妖各个幻化的丰乳翘臀，洛红颜自己也是身材高挑柔美。
而长卿本就高，穿上暴露的女装活像个竹竿。
“还有你这张面瘫脸和死鱼眼。”
“是男人的时候还好，化妆成女人后怎么看怎么别扭，你就不能改改么。”
长卿无奈。
“要不然就这样算了吧，我感觉离得远一点，也未必有人能看出来。”
“那可不行，你这人平时怪谨慎的，到这种时候怎么又大意了呢。”
说罢，洛红颜手指一点，一枚乳白色的御灵浮现，她伸手点在长卿的胸前，又向后划过长卿的臀部。
少女手指的触感让长卿身体一颤。
紧接着，一股奇怪的感觉袭来，只见他的胸前迅速鼓胀开来，臀部也开始翘起，顿时把整个衣服撑得前凸后翘，曲线诱人。
如果说之前他是个竹竿，现在彻底变成了熟透的水蜜桃。
“嘿嘿，这下可以了。”洛红颜狡黠地一笑。
“不用担心，这个是我自己炼出来的小御灵，就是个肉色的坚固气泡，能改变形状，把你的衣服撑起来，改变体态的障眼法而已。”
长卿并没有很吃惊，这世上的御灵千奇百怪，有什么功能都不奇怪。
他的目光倒是瞥向洛红颜胸前的两团丰硕。
“你这个不会也是......”

洛红颜赶忙捂住胸口，气愤道。
“登徒子，我这当然是真的了！我假给谁看？再看给你的死鱼眼戳瞎。”
说罢，她撇过头去不再看长卿。
“你走路的时候把头低一点，别让人看到你的那副死人表情，走了。”
不得不说，人只要心态一改变，看待事物的方式都变了，前一世长卿将洛红颜视作提线木偶，对于她说的话，做的事，都心如止水，毫无波澜。
可这一世，他已经自动把洛红颜面具下的表情脑补成了叶清荷耍小性子时娇憨的可爱模样，看洛红颜也是分外顺眼。
他伸出手，放在洛红颜头顶，抚了抚她柔顺的秀发。
“好了好了，对不起，我不该逗你的，你这个御灵蛮有趣，可以送我一个么？”
洛红颜被他这么一摸，也泄了气。
长卿这人很奇怪，明明表情冷漠，可对自己说话时总是带着若有若无的温柔宠溺，让人没法真正生他的气。
只是他这种死皮赖脸自来熟的感觉，还有总是想要接近自己的行为让人莫名其妙。
洛红颜拍掉了长卿的手，“给你给你，以后不许随便碰我。”
“遵命，以后碰你之前我会申请的。”
长卿接过那枚乳白色的御灵，直接吸入窍穴之内。
他现在是倏忽二转，体内正好有两个窍穴，一枚是他原本就有的骨刺灵，一枚是这个气泡灵。
“咦？你怎么不需要炼化，直接就吸入窍穴之内了？”

"You look like you can barely get by, but your figure is too bland."
Luo Hongyan held her chin and tasted it.
She simply applied some rouge to Chang Qing to cover up his pale complexion, and combed his long hair up to look like a woman's hairstyle.
However, she was not very satisfied with Changqing's figure.
Indeed, I don't blame her for being picky. The succubus in this hole has big breasts and perky buttocks, and Luo Hongyan herself is also tall and graceful.
Changqing, on the other hand, is already tall, and looks like a bamboo pole in revealing women's clothing.
"And your paralyzed face and dead fish eyes."
"It's okay when you're a man, but it looks awkward when you make up as a woman. Can't you change it?"
Changqing is helpless.
"Otherwise, let's forget it. If I feel further away, no one may be able to see it."
"That's not possible. You are usually very cautious. Why are you so careless at a time like this?"
After that, Luo Hongyan pointed her finger, and a milky-white Yuling appeared. She reached out and touched Changqing's chest, and then moved back across Changqing's buttocks.
The touch of the girl's fingers made Changqing tremble.
Immediately afterwards, a strange feeling came over him. His chest quickly swelled and his buttocks began to rise, which suddenly made the whole clothes bulge forward and backward, creating an attractive curve.
If he was a bamboo pole before, now he has completely turned into a ripe peach.
"Hehe, it's okay now." Luo Hongyan smiled slyly.
"Don't worry, this is the little Yuling that I made myself. It's just a flesh-colored solid bubble that can change its shape, hold up your clothes, and change your posture. It's just a deception."
Chang Qing was not very surprised. There are all kinds of strange spirits in this world, and it is not surprising that they have any functions.
His eyes glanced at the two plump lumps on Luo Hongyan's chest.
"You can't be the same..."
Luo Hongyan quickly covered her chest and said angrily.
"You bastard, of course I am telling the truth! Who am I to show it to? Then I will blind you with my dead eyes."
After saying that, she turned her head and stopped looking at Chang Qing.
"When you walk, lower your head. Don't let others see your dead expression. Let's go."
It has to be said that as soon as a person's mentality changes, the way he looks at things changes. In the previous life, Chang Qing regarded Luo Hongyan as a puppet on strings. He was calm and calm about everything she said and did.
But in this life, he had automatically imagined the expression under Luo Hongyan's mask to look like Ye Qinghe's petite and cute look when he was acting petty, and he found Luo Hongyan particularly pleasing to the eye.
He stretched out his hand, placed it on Luo Hongyan's head, and stroked her silky hair.
"Okay, okay, I'm sorry, I shouldn't have teased you. You are a very interesting Yuling. Can you give me one?"
Luo Hongyan was also discouraged when he touched her like this.
Chang Qing is a very strange person. He has a cold expression, but when he talks to himself, he always speaks with a hint of tenderness and pampering, making it impossible for people to really be angry with him.
It's just that his shameless and familiar feeling and his behavior of always wanting to get close to him are baffling.
Luo Hongyan slapped Chang Qing's hand away, "Here it is, give it to you, don't touch me casually in the future."
"Yes, I will apply before I touch you in the future."
Changqing took the milky white imperial spirit and inhaled it directly into the acupoint.
He is now in a sudden second transformation, and there are exactly two acupoints in his body, one is the bone spur spirit that he originally had, and the other is this bubble spirit.
"Huh? Why did you just inhale it directly into the acupoints without refining it?"
